data.narrative:
Improbable Defence is a Growth-stage defense and security company that has raised $703M to date. The valuation landscape for this segment includes two public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and eight private peers, with notable private competitors including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic.

A Stage-Progression methodology was applied to triangulate value, using the $703M total raised as a proxy for current enterprise value and applying a 1.2x step-up multiplier typical of Growth-stage advancement. This yielded an implied valuation of $844M. A Peer-Median approach was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the Defense & Security sector; while 26 same-sector peers exist broadly, none met the filter criteria of three or more datapoints at matching stage or valuation tier.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $717M (low) to $970M (high), with a median point estimate of $844M. This range reflects limited methodological coverage—derived from a single applicable triangulation method—and underscores the key uncertainty around appropriate peer multiples in this nascent segment. Further clarity on comparable transaction multiples and revenue/profitability benchmarks within frontier defense would strengthen conviction in this range.
